data.body:
## A home with room to breathe

Morning light across the kitchen. French doors open to a sheltered garden. A quiet room upstairs for work, and space around the table when everyone comes home.

This is a fictional example, with illustrative photographs from different homes. It is not a property for sale. Confirm every fact and use the owner’s actual photographs for a real listing.

Explore the rooms at your own pace.

!embed[Explore the 3D tour](https://my.matterport.com/show/?m=DemoModel123)

## Open house

Saturday, October 24 · 1–3 pm. Visits at other times by appointment. Ask about access or anything you need before you arrive.

## The details

- Three bedrooms, including a quiet room for work or guests
- Two bathrooms and a separate utility area
- A sheltered garden with room to sit outside
- Parking and access details confirmed before a visit
